questions.solution:
The most appropriate antonym of "acrimonious" is "amicable."

Greed

questions.solution:
The most appropriate antonym of the underlined word "Generosity" is "Greed"

Explanation:

questions.question: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. Arriving late /the student /slipped into the room /where everyone stared at them.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

Arriving late /the student /slipped into the room /where everyone stared at them.

options.html: the student
slipped into the room
where everyone stared at them
Arriving late

questions.solution:
The correct alternative is "where everyone stared at them".

Explanation:

  • Since "the student" is singular, the pronoun must match in number. Therefore, "them" should be replaced with "him" or "her", depending on the student's gender.
  • If the gender of the student is not specified, you can use "his/her" as a gender-neutral alternative, or simply "their" if you prefer a gender-neutral option.

So, the sentence would read correctly as:

"Arriving late, the student slipped into the room where everyone stared at him/her."

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the bold sentence. A remedy for all diseases
questions.questionHtml:

A remedy for all diseases

options.html: Panacea
Elixir
Antidote
Placebo

questions.solution:
The correct one-word substitute for "A remedy for all diseases" is "Panacea"

Explanation:

  • Panacea refers to a solution or remedy for all problems or diseases, making it the most accurate one-word substitute.
  • Elixir is typically a medicinal solution, but it doesn’t imply a cure for all diseases like "panacea."

Thus, "Panacea" is the best choice.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech. “Wow! What a beautiful painting!” she said.

options.html: She said that it was a beautiful painting.

options.html: She wondered if it was a beautiful painting.

options.html: She exclaimed with admiration that it was a beautiful painting.

questions.solution:
The correct option is "She exclaimed with admiration that it was a beautiful painting."

Explanation:

  • In indirect speech, the exclamation "Wow! What a beautiful painting!" is expressing a strong emotion or admiration. The phrase "exclaimed with admiration" is appropriate to convey the excitement and admiration in indirect speech.

  • "She wondered if it was a beautiful painting" implies doubt or uncertainty, which is not in line with the enthusiastic exclamation.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech. Rahul told me that he would finish the project by next day.

Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Rahul told me that he would finish the project by next day.

options.text: Rahul told me, “He will finish the project by tomorrow.”

questions.solution:

Explanation:

In direct speech, the exact words spoken by a person are quoted directly, without any changes. The pronoun and tense are adjusted to reflect what was actually said.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. The novel's _______ plot kept readers hooked until the very last page.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

The novel's _______ plot kept readers hooked until the very last page.

options.html: Greedy
Gripping
Grating
Grumpy

questions.solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "Gripping."

Explanation:

  • Gripping means something that holds attention tightly, which fits well with the context of a novel that keeps readers hooked until the last page.
  • Greedy refers to an excessive desire for something, usually money or possessions, and doesn't fit the context of a plot.
  • Grating means something harsh or unpleasant, which would not describe a plot that keeps readers engaged.
  • Grumpy refers to being irritable or in a bad mood, which doesn't fit the context of a novel's plot.

Thus, "Gripping" is the best choice, as it describes a plot that is engaging and captivating.

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
1. After a few minutes, the train pulled into the station, and I stepped out onto the platform.
2. I boarded the train early in the morning, just as the sun was rising.
3. The scenery outside was breathtaking, with rolling hills and picturesque villages passing by.
4. As the train chugged along, I settled into my seat with a book, enjoying the peaceful journey.

options.html: 2134
2431
3214
2413

questions.solution:
The correct order is 2431.

Explanation:

  • Sentence 2 starts the paragraph, describing the action of boarding the train early in the morning, just as the sun is rising.
  • Sentence 4 continues the sequence, explaining how the speaker settled into the seat with a book, enjoying the peaceful journey.
  • Sentence 3 follows logically, describing the breathtaking scenery outside the train as it moves along.
  • Sentence 1 concludes the paragraph by describing the arrival of the train at the station, with the speaker stepping onto the platform.

A person who avoids social interaction

options.html: Vagabond
Recluse
Extrovert
Optimist

questions.solution:
The correct one-word substitute for "A person who avoids social interaction" is "Recluse"

Explanation:

  • A recluse is a person who lives a solitary life and avoids social interaction.
  • A vagabond refers to a person who travels from place to place, often without a permanent home, but doesn't necessarily avoid social interaction.
  • An extrovert is someone who is outgoing and enjoys socializing, which is the opposite of avoiding social interaction.
  • An optimist is a person who tends to be hopeful and positive, which is unrelated to avoiding social interaction.

questions.solution:
The correct synonym for "Elusive" is "Evade."

Explanation:

B. Point Nemo is the furthest point from land on Earth. C. questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A. Officially known as the oceanic point of inaccessibility, it's located in the centre of the triangle made by Ducie Island, Motu Nui (part of the Easter Island chain) and Maher Island near Antarctica.
B. Point Nemo is the furthest point from land on Earth.
C. It is so far from land that the closest humans to Point Nemo are usually astronauts—the International Space Station orbits the Earth from a distance of about 258 miles.
D. While the closest inhabited spot to Point Nemo is more than 1670 miles away.

options.html: BACD
BADC
BCDA
BCAD

questions.solution:
The correct order is BACD.

Explanation:

  • B: "Point Nemo is the furthest point from land on Earth." This sentence serves as a strong introduction to the topic.
  • A: "Officially known as the oceanic point of inaccessibility, it's located in the centre of the triangle made by Ducie Island, Motu Nui (part of the Easter Island chain) and Maher Island near Antarctica." This sentence gives more geographical details, explaining where Point Nemo is located.
  • C: "It is so far from land that the closest humans to Point Nemo are usually astronauts—the International Space Station orbits the Earth from a distance of about 258 miles." This elaborates on how far Point Nemo is from land and introduces the idea of astronauts being the closest humans.
  • D: "While the closest inhabited spot to Point Nemo is more than 1670 miles away." This sentence concludes with additional details on the remoteness of Point Nemo.

  • "Pull an all-nighter" means staying up all night to work on something, which is also the opposite of deciding to rest.

(3)_________, a bear market occurs when stock prices fall, often due to economic uncertainty or poor corporate performance.

Investors use various strategies to make decisions in the stock market. Some rely on fundamental analysis, which involves studying a company's financial statements and market position. Others prefer technical analysis, which focuses on historical price trends and market patterns. Regardless of the approach, the stock market carries (4)______ risks, and investors must be prepared for volatility.

Governments and regulatory bodies play a crucial role in ensuring the stock market operates fairly. They enforce rules to prevent insider trading and protect investors from fraud. Additionally, central banks may intervene in the stock market (5)________ adjusting interest rates to stabilize the economy during periods of recession.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 4.

options.html: Avoidable
Limited
Minimal
Inherent

questions.solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in blank 4 is "Inherent."

Explanation:

  • "Inherent" means something that is a permanent and essential part of something. In this context, it refers to the fact that risks are a natural part of the stock market. No matter how much analysis or strategy is used, risk is an inherent (essential and unavoidable) part of investing in the stock market.

The other options are incorrect because:

  • "Avoidable" means something that can be prevented, which is not true in the case of the risks of the stock market — they cannot be completely avoided.
  • "Limited" means something restricted in extent or quantity, which doesn't fit the context of the stock market, where risks are not necessarily limited.
  • "Minimal" means very small, but stock market risks are not minimal; they can vary in size and are often significant, depending on various factors.
